title: 🦍 Baby Boom at the L.A. Zoo! 🎉
description:
Say hello to the fifth great ape born at the Los Angeles Zoo this year — a western lowland gorilla infant welcomed on Saturday, November 22! 💚

Born to proud parents N’djia (31) and silverback Kelly (38), this little one joins big sister Angela (born in 2020).  Visitors can catch a glimpse of baby at the Zoo's Campo Gorilla Reserve.
